description: Build the Reminders, Events, and EventDetail screens — the core CRUD pages. Depends on FEAT-002 (API services and types already exist). Independent of FEAT-004 (Capture/Memory/Settings).
steps: Create web/src/features/reminders/CreateReminderModal.tsx: modal dialog with fields: title (required text), description (textarea), reminder_type (select: time/deadline/recurring/follow-up/multi-stage), scheduled_at (datetime-local input), timezone (text, default UTC), priority (select: low/medium/high/critical), alarm_enabled (toggle), notification_enabled (toggle), recurrence_rule (text, optional), offsets (text input, comma-separated, e.g. -3d,-1h). Submit calls createReminder(); closes modal and invalidates React Query cache on success.

Create web/src/features/reminders/RemindersScreen.tsx: filter tabs All/Active/Completed/Overdue (Overdue = scheduled_at<now AND status=active). List renders each reminder as a row card: title, priority Badge, scheduled_at formatted with date-fns, status Badge, action buttons (Mark Complete → PATCH status=completed, Delete → DELETE). 'New Reminder' button opens CreateReminderModal. 'Parse with AI' button opens a textarea; on submit calls aiApi.parseReminder, shows the parsed result in a preview card with a 'Create this reminder' confirm button (user must confirm before POST, per R1.9). Empty state if no reminders.

Create web/src/features/events/CreateEventModal.tsx: fields: title (required), description (textarea), event_type (select: hackathon/conference/workshop/webinar/meetup/meeting/appointment/deadline/custom), start_at (datetime-local, required), end_at (datetime-local, optional), timezone (text), location (text), is_virtual (toggle), event_url (url input), organizer (text), registration_url (url input). Deadlines section: dynamic list of deadline rows (title, deadline_type, deadline_at). Add/remove rows. Submit calls createEvent(); invalidates cache on success.

Create web/src/features/events/EventsScreen.tsx: list of events with filter tabs by status. Each event card: title, event_type badge, start_at, end_at, location or 'Virtual' chip, capture count chips (photo/voice/doc), status badge. Click navigates to /events/:id. 'New Event' button opens CreateEventModal. 'Extract from text' button: paste area → aiApi.extractEvent → pre-fills CreateEventModal (user still submits manually).

Create web/src/features/events/EventDetailScreen.tsx: fetches event by id (GET /events/:id). Header: title, event_type badge, status badge, start/end dates, location, organizer, event_url link. Tabs implemented with simple state: Overview | Captures | Deadlines | Reminders | Summary. Overview tab: all event fields in a read layout; 'Edit' button opens an inline edit form (PATCH fields). Captures tab: useQuery listCaptures({event_id}); shows each capture with type icon, processing_status badge, ai_result summary if available. Deadlines tab: lists event.deadlines; 'Add Deadline' form at bottom (POST /events/:id/deadlines). Reminders tab: 'Preview Reminder Policy' button → GET /events/:id/reminder-policy → shows a table of proposed reminders → 'Apply Policy' button → POST /events/:id/reminder-policy (creates reminders). Summary tab: if event.summary_id show GET /events/:id/summary as structured card (overview, key_topics chips, key_takeaways list, action_items list, decisions list, important_people list, resources list); else show 'Generate AI Summary' button → POST /events/:id/generate-summary → spinner → display result. Update App.tsx to replace the events and events/:id placeholder routes with the real screens.
Update web/src/App.tsx to wire /reminders → RemindersScreen and /events → EventsScreen and /events/:id → EventDetailScreen (removing the placeholders from FEAT-002).
acceptance_criteria: `cd web && npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
Reminders screen lists, creates, completes, and deletes reminders against real backend
AI parse-reminder flow shows preview and requires confirm before saving
Events screen lists and creates events
EventDetail tabs all render without crash; Summary generation calls POST /events/:id/generate-summary
findings: 1. App.tsx was already correctly wired from FEAT-002 stubs — real screens drop in as direct replacements with no routing changes needed. 2. CreateReminderModal and CreateEventModal accept an optional prefill prop to support AI parse/extract flows. 3. AI parse-reminder flow strictly requires user confirmation (preview card + 'Create this reminder' button) before POSTing, per R1.9. 4. AI extract-event flow pre-fills CreateEventModal; user must submit manually — AI result is never auto-saved. 5. EventDetail Reminders tab: 'Preview Reminder Policy' calls GET and shows table; 'Apply Policy' button only calls POST after user clicks — not auto-applied. 6. EventDetail Summary tab: 'Generate AI Summary' button calls POST /events/:id/generate-summary on press only; existing summary_id triggers GET /events/:id/summary on load. 7. capturesApi.listCaptures already accepts event_id param — no changes needed to FEAT-002 files. 8. Build passes: 527 modules transformed, 0 TypeScript errors, dist/ produced in 2.23s.
